Claire / Akira — thanks for the patience. Sending final assets for print and AV playback. Summary below and attachments are included.

What we attached:
- sponsor-stand-visuals_v3.pdf (final dielines and print-ready PDFs sized for East Hall panels)
- onepager_acme_case_v2.pdf (print-ready, 300dpi, CMYK)
- demo-scene-stitch.mov (45s silent loop with embedded captions; MP4 export available on request)
- floorplan_acme-booth.pdf (updated with signage callouts)

Notes / playback guidance:
- The demo loop was exported at 1080p H.264, 29.97fps. If you need a 4K file or a different codec for your playback system, tell us and we will provide an MP4.
- Captioning is baked into the MP4; we can also provide a separate SRT if you want to display captions via the venue player.
- Kimberly finalized the copy; Marcus confirmed the three-impact metric bullets (latency: 60% median reduction; cost: ~38% per-token savings; availability: 99.95% SLA).

Next steps:
- Claire / Akira: confirm sign-off for print and AV by Oct 22 so we can meet the printer cutoff.
- If you want us to upload directly to the venue media player, share an FTP or WeTransfer endpoint.

Thanks — excited to see this on the floor.
